data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Manas', which means 'to remember'. Manusriyyah means 'a gift from Allah, a reminder from God'. This name holds a spiritual significance as it serves as a reminder of Allah's blessings and favors. The name Manusriyyah carries the meaning “Gift from Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manusriyyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
